home.metaDescription: Mobile money payment aggregation platform for Central Africa. One integration, multiple operators.
home.heroSubtitle: One API to accept payments from your customers, whatever their operator. Reliable, secure, built for Central Africa.
home.feature1Text: Connect multiple operators through one clear, versioned REST API.
home.feature2Text: HMAC-signed webhooks, idempotency, encryption of sensitive data.
home.feature3Text: Live transaction statuses and reliable webhook notifications with retry.
home.trustText: Clear dashboard, API keys, webhook logs, reconciliation. Everything you need to operate with confidence.

solution.title: A complete payment infrastructure
solution.subtitle: From payment initiation to settlement, PayBrain handles the full lifecycle.
solution.block1Text: Initiate payments and generate hosted payment links in a few lines.
solution.block2Text: Signed outbound webhooks, with scheduled retries and queryable logs.
solution.block3Text: Merchant dashboard: transactions, API keys, webhooks, profile.
